message: Add AE badges, paper PDF, and overview figure to README
docs: fix stray samples/malicious reference in README

samples: flatten layout to samples/math-calculator (drop malicious/ path)

The intermediate 'malicious' directory leaked into the skill path passed to the triage/agent; flattening keeps detection driven by the skill's code, not its path. Scripts and README updated to point at samples/.

Merge pull request #13 from protectskills/fix/cc-analyze-json-shape

Dynamic-execution robustness fixes and a controlled malicious sample

samples: add defanged malicious sample with CC-triage and dynamic reproduction; default CC model to haiku; document API-key/model setup

Add samples/malicious/math-calculator (confirmed malicious skill rest_1659) with its reverse-shell endpoint defanged to 127.0.0.1. samples/run_cc.sh runs the Claude Code triage (pipeline step 8) on it; samples/run_detection.sh runs the dynamic sandbox. Default CC_MODEL is now the robust 'haiku' alias (still overridable via CC_MODEL or a settings.json env block). README documents using an API key or an Anthropic-compatible endpoint (e.g. GLM).

executor: guard empty SETTINGS_ENV_ARGS under set -u; raise default exec timeout

run_skill_hostauth.sh used "${SETTINGS_ENV_ARGS[@]}", which trips an unbound-variable error under set -u on bash 3.2 (default on macOS) when no settings env-file is present; use the ${arr[@]+...} form so an empty array expands to nothing safely. Raise the default EXEC_TIMEOUT from 240 to 600 to reduce spurious execution timeouts.

analyzer: tolerate non-object CC triage responses

cc_analyzer.sh injected run metadata assuming the model returned a JSON object; a top-level array made the step raise AttributeError and abort the task under set -e. Inject metadata only for object responses and pass other shapes through, so a non-object response routes to the ERROR bucket instead of failing the run.
analysis: add E1 dataset count check (stdlib, no deps)

executor: take run status from Claude's exit code; default strace off on macOS

run_skill_hostauth.sh derives the run result from Claude's own exit code and gates strace behind USE_STRACE. In-container ptrace is unreliable in the Docker Desktop VM on macOS, so syscall tracing defaults off there (Linux keeps it on); override with USE_STRACE. README documents host jq, GNU timeout/coreutils, Claude Code install/login, and USE_STRACE.

Merge pull request #9 from protectskills/repro/preserve-env-on-load-tar

Preserve helper env when loading sandbox archives

Preserve helper env when loading sandbox archives

Loading a Docker image tar updates DOCKER_IMAGE in the local env file. Preserve active local settings such as SkillsMP, GitHub, Claude, and Docker command values during that writeback, and resolve tar paths relative to both code/ and the repository root so menu input is less fragile.

Constraint: Users may initialize or export required credentials before importing the prebuilt sandbox image.
Rejected: Requiring another init after image load | hides the writeback problem and breaks the menu flow.
Confidence: high
Scope-risk: narrow

Not-tested: Real Docker load on the remote server.

Make dynamic execution outcomes artifact-first

The dynamic runner now treats normal completion and timeout-with-monitoring-artifacts as one compatible success model, while optional execution reports add evidence instead of changing the accounting path. The helper, manual script, and hostauth executor now agree on report-mode timeout selection and boolean parsing, and host Claude settings can supply auth without copying secrets into tracked files.

Constraint: Dynamic runs often produce NOVA reports before Claude emits final --print output.
Constraint: Existing queue state files may contain earlier timeout/report status names.
Rejected: Separate report-mode success statuses | would make helper summaries and state skipping diverge by configuration.
Rejected: Always increasing EXEC_TIMEOUT | wastes model budget and hides useful timeout-captured results.
Confidence: high
Scope-risk: moderate
Directive: Keep batch success accounting artifact-first; report files should remain supplemental evidence, not a separate success path.

Tested: bash -n code/executor/run_skill_hostauth.sh code/scripts/06_execute.sh

Tested: hostauth dry-run with fake docker command and settings auth
Tested: helper load-tar fake docker import updates DOCKER_IMAGE
Not-tested: Real Claude Code dynamic execution, to avoid model quota use.

Support offline lite sandbox image import

Support offline lite sandbox image import

Publish the prebuilt lite sandbox as a GitHub release asset and let helper import a local tar/tar.gz archive through image mode. This keeps GHCR as the normal path while giving restricted-network hosts a no-registry fallback.
